texts.preamble: Snehashis Sarkar vs The State Of Jharkhand ... Opposite ... on 28 July, 2021 Author: Anil Kumar Choudhary Bench: Anil Kumar Choudhary In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi A.B.A. No. 4662 of 2021 ------ Snehashis Sarkar ... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand ... Opposite Party ------ Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Choudhary
texts.arguments: Learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner personally undertakes to remove the defects as pointed out by the stamp reporter within two weeks after the lockdown period is over. In view of the personal undertaking of the learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner, the defects pointed out by the stamp reporter are ignored for the present. Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Drugs & Cosmetics Case No.01 of 2020 registered under sections 27 (b) (ii) and 27 (d) of Drugs & Cosmetics Act, 1940. The Learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the drug inspector raided the premises of M/s. Cipla Limited and seized three medicines being Neuro Gardian, Fit eye tablet and Fit eye plus cap. It is further alleged that the admissible range of Pyridoxine Hydrochloride is from 1.5 to 3 mg but the Neuro Gardian seized by the drug inspector shows that it contained Pyridoxine Hydrochloride 24 mg which is eight times of the maximum admissible therapeutic dose. Similarly, though the therapeutic dose range of Methylcobalamine is 5 to 15 mcg but the Neuro Gardian seized contains Methylcobalamine in 1500 mcg which is 100 times the maximum therapeutic dose. Similarly, though the therapeutic dose Snehashis Sarkar vs The State Of Jharkhand ... Opposite ... on 28 July, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128073780/ 1 range of Alpha Tocopheryl is 15 to 25 IU but the Neuro Gardian seized contains Aplha Tocopheryl in 19.46 mg. It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and this case has been foisted on the basis of surmises and presumption and conjectures. It is further submitted that all the three products comes under the proprietary food and not for medicinal use and the same has been specified in the label of every product. It is next submitted that the therapeutic dose range as mentioned in the complaint is wrong because of the Food Safety and Standard Authority of India under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, who has constituted the Expert Committee of ICMR which specified that TUL of micronutrients for Indian population and the dose range of the products in question are well within the specified limit as prescribed by the Expert Committee. It is then submitted that the Nuero Gardian dose range is 100 mg/day, and Methylcobalamine (Vitamin B12) dose range is 1500 mcg and Vitamin E (Powder Form) as per ICMR, the dose range is 1000 mg/ day. It is next submitted by the learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner by drawing attention of this Court to the Expert Committee Report kept at Annexure-4 at page no.70 which shows the following :- iii) Pyridoxine:- A few studies of India used 1-10 mg/day of vitamin B6(pyridoxine) involving 5-15 year boys/girls or women (Table B6- Indian Studies Recommendation: Adult TUL of 100 mg/ day vii) Vitamin B12:- In the case of vitamin B12 studies used 500 ug on non- pregnant vegetarian women and 1-10 ug on children (Table: B12- Indian Studies). Recommendation: No TUL identified. Vitamin E Nutrient Children Adolescent Pregnant/Lactating Adults (6-9Y) (9-17Y) women Vitamin E 200 (1-9Y) 800 1000 1000 It is further submitted that there is nothing wrong with the medicines. It is then submitted that the petitioner is ready and willing to cooperate with the trial of the case.
